codeReview.summary: The fix correctly replaces `sys.exit(1)` with a module-level `pytestmark = pytest.mark.skip(...)` inside the `except ImportError` block in `tests/security/test_advanced_malware_classifier.py`. This is the idiomatic pytest pattern for conditionally skipping an entire module when optional dependencies are missing. The change is minimal (8 lines changed in the test file), preserves all existing test content, and achieves the stated goal: pytest collection no longer aborts with SystemExit, and all 4 tests in the file are reported as skipped when `ai_enhanced_data_models` / `ml_malware_classifier` are absent. Verified locally: `pytest --collect-only` collects 4 items, and `pytest -v` reports 4 skipped in ~0.36s. No other test files in the repo use `sys.exit`, so this was the only collection blocker of this kind. The commit also updates `.factory/library/pipeline-upgrade.md` with accurate documentation and narrows the `.factory/services.yaml` test command to `pytest tests/unit/ tests/integration/ -n 4 --ignore=tests/performance --ignore=tests/poc` to provide a realistic scoped baseline.
